visual_elements.description: Scatter plot with x-axis labeled 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and y-axis labeled 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. Light gray gridlines at major ticks. Four main clusters: black dots centered around x=12, y=20; magenta dots centered around x=18, y=20; green ring-shaped cluster centered around x=15, y=10 with a cyan/light blue hole at its center; blue elongated cluster centered around x=35, y=17. Red dots are scattered as outliers across the right side and surrounding areas, roughly x=28-48, y=8-28. One thin gray arrow points from upper-left toward the blue cluster.

recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#F0F0F0).
2. Insert a white (#FFFFFF) rectangle with a thin dark (#000000) border positioned in the middle center, spanning roughly x=22% to x=78% and y=10% to y=90% of the slide, to serve as the chart frame.
3. Inside the rectangle, create a scatter plot chart with the x-axis scaled from 0 to 50 and the y-axis scaled from 0 to 30.
4. Add light gray (#CCCCCC) gridlines at all major tick marks on both axes.
5. Add x-axis tick labels in black (#000000) sans-serif text at the positions 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50.
6. Add y-axis tick labels in black (#000000) sans-serif text at the positions 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30.
7. Plot a cluster of black (#000000) dots centered around coordinates x=12, y=20.
8. Plot a cluster of magenta (#FF00FF) dots centered around coordinates x=18, y=20.
9. Plot a ring-shaped cluster of green (#00FF00) dots centered around coordinates x=15, y=10, leaving a circular gap at the center.
10. Place a cyan/light blue (#00FFFF) filled circle at the center of the green ring (x=15, y=10) to create the hole effect.
11. Plot an elongated cluster of blue (#0000FF) dots centered around coordinates x=35, y=17.
12. Scatter red (#FF0000) dots as outliers across the region roughly x=28 to x=48 and y=8 to y=28.
13. Add a thin gray (#808080) arrow pointing from the upper-left toward the blue cluster.
14. Add the text "44" in bold black (#000000) sans-serif font inside a yellow (#FFD700) oval with a black (#000000) border at the top-right corner of the slide.
